STEP 6 - Grams: Sausage pieces with gaps between them have a bulk density of about 0.7 g/ml. That gives 353 × 0.7 ≈ 247 g, which I round to about 245 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked smoked sausage is about 300 kcal per 100 g. So 245 g × 3.0 ≈ 735 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 14 slices at roughly 17 g each comes to about 240 g. This matches the volume estimate, so the total is plausible.
